description.en: Light enough to fly past most of your plants in the air.
description.zh: 身体轻盈，能越过大部分防线。

chat.en: Qinggong mastery - light as a swallow.
chat.zh: 掌握了轻功的精髓——身轻如燕。

text.en: frequently hops up and flies past most of your defences
text.zh: 经常跳起并悬浮在空中，越过你的大部分植物

text.en: can be blocked by Tall-nuts while flying
text.zh: 飞行时会被高坚果阻挡
